open_points.subject: Agent may-author right scope across create/change actions (functions vs flows/bindings)
open_points.text: "the token says whether the agent may author" versus action rows where only some actions are marked "agent with author right" while "compose and prove a flow" and "propose an operation binding" are just "agent".
open_points.question: Which product actions are actually gated by the may-author flag?
options: Only actions explicitly labeled "agent with author right" require may-author; compose/propose stay allowed for any agent token.
Any action that creates or changes kernel artifacts (including flow composition and binding proposal) requires may-author.
A specific enumerated subset beyond the table requires may-author.
open_points.default_guess: Use the action table literally: require may-author only where that phrase is explicitly present.

open_points.subject: Approval authority for draft-write after outcome resolved not_applied
open_points.text: K-08 says runtime approval stops are for "state-transition", "external-effect" and "destructive" nodes, and "a `draft-write` runs under the owner's activation of the flow instead"; but it also says "An effect resolved as not applied is sent again only with a fresh approval" and M26 says resend after `not_applied`, "whatever its class, records the fresh approval it needed."
open_points.question: After an `unknown` outcome is resolved as `not_applied`, must a `draft-write` resend obtain a fresh EffectApproval, or can it resend under flow activation/grant rules without per-send approval?
options: Fresh approval is required for all effect classes except read, including draft-write resends.
Fresh approval rule applies only to classes that normally require per-send approval; draft-write still uses flow activation authority.
Draft-write resends are disallowed entirely after not_applied.
open_points.default_guess: Require a fresh approval even for draft-write resends, because the resend rule is stated as class-independent.

open_points.subject: Inspect action read scope for spooled file bytes
open_points.text: State 0 inspect output is "typed description"; M22 says spooled files are read "by the owner inspecting its bytes — part of the State 0 inspect action".
open_points.question: Does inspect return raw spooled file bytes to the owner (while spool exists), or only metadata/digests in typed descriptions?
options: Inspect is metadata-only; no raw bytes are returned by this action.
Owner inspect can include raw bytes for spooled files while retained; agents still get personal_data as digest/class.
Bytes are available only through a separate read action not yet defined.
open_points.default_guess: Allow owner inspect to read spooled file bytes while the spool is retained, with agent redaction rules unchanged.
